study_design_rigor.quote: A sample "passed" if it achieved a median coverage ≥50x, covered ≥90% of the reference genome, and contained fewer than 20 minor single-nucleotide variants (SNVs) with frequency ≥5%.

results_and_conclusion.justification: Table 1 labels counts totaling 3,919 as SARI and 7,955 as ILI, whereas the text reports 7,955 SARI and 3,965 ILI and reverses the cited 6–11-month count; Figure 10a reports N75 at 90.7% and describes n=34, contrary to the universal 43-isolate N75 claim repeated in the conclusion. Figure 12b's displayed panel also states N=01 despite the narrative RSV-B analysis using six genomes; these direct inconsistencies match score_1 because the conclusions are not consistently grounded in the displayed data.
results_and_conclusion.quote: all 43 Bangladeshi RSV-A isolates uniformly acquired a novel, high-confidence glycosylation site at position N75

references.justification: The references include foundational RSV burden, glycoprotein biology, and phylogenetic-classification studies alongside recent RSV surveillance and intervention literature, and are predominantly peer-reviewed. However, reference 6 is a medRxiv preprint, and reference 56 (Beilleau et al., on pestivirus RNase E(rns)) is clearly unrelated to RSV surveillance, RSV glycosylation, or the stated methods.
